title: Close GF(p) FieldMatrix gaps to fflas-ffpack
description:
Close GF(p) FieldMatrix performance gaps to fflas-ffpack.

## Background

Mersenne31 is already strong in measured GEMM rows, but GF(7), GF(31), GF(251), and GF(65521) need dedicated small-prime and medium-prime work to meet the 1.5x threshold.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] GF(p) GEMM target rows are within 1.5x of fflas-ffpack or faster across all in-scope prime families, except rows explicitly amended to `[aspirational]` with user-approved empirical justification.
- [hard] Dense GF(p) rows downstream of GEMM have follow-up dependencies or evidence showing they inherit the optimized kernels.
- [hard] A final GF(p) report records raw numbers, ratios, and field-family-specific decisions.

## Amendment — 2026-05-06 (user-approved)

GF(251) rows are accepted as `[aspirational]` for this story. The measured GF(251) ratios remain below the 1.5x-of-fflas threshold because fflas-ffpack uses an OpenBLAS-backed float-modular cascade, while gf2-core's current path is a pure AVX2 hand-written packed-byte kernel. This amendment does not make the GF(251) gap uninteresting; it makes it non-blocking for `cc5de315` closure. Follow-up issue `615db3b9` tracks the requested push toward fflas-like GF(251) performance after this story closes.
